title: Linkedia Daily Edition (v2)
description: One file per published date: content/editions/YYYY-MM-DD.json. article_ids order is display order; the first article is the lead story. Several publication batches may add articles to the same day: published_at keeps the first batch's time and updated_at the latest; each v2 article carries its own published_at.

published_at.description: First publication of this edition (export time declared by the engine).

updated_at.description: Latest batch added to this edition; equals published_at for a single batch.

visual_theme_id.description: Legacy (v1 reading themes, retired by D-081); optional.
